tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul srid zhi'i dpal 'byor rab rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na saṃ bha wa ya/ sdom pa dang dam tshig gtsang zhing / dad gus mos pa'i gdung shugs drag po dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnal 'byor bsgom par 'dod pas/ bla ma'i sku 'bag gam/ dbu skra na bza' phyag sen sogs dmigs rten gyi drung du dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod pa nam mkha' gang bar bshams/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod la/ bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /mkha' mnyam yid can srid las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi/ /lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ mdun rten la dmigs te/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod/ chos kun mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /bai ḍūr+ya yi sa gzhi rgya che ba'i/ /dbus su rin chen sna tshogs las grub khri/ /pad+ma nyi zla lnga brtsegs gdan steng du/ /bka' drin zla med rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /rnam pa yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku/ /btso ma gser gyi mdangs 'od rab tu 'tsher/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgyas dgos 'dod rtsol/ /g.yon pa ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can/ /rin chen rgyan spras dar gyi na bzas mdzes/ /mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs 'od zer bye ba 'gyed/ /zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /mtha' skor rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang / /khyad par nam mkha' mdzod dang rnam thos sras/ /rmugs 'dzin rigs lnga lha mo nor rgyun ma/ /tshogs kyi bdag po kun 'khyil mched gsum dang / /myur mdzad yid bzhin nor bu la sogs pa'i/ /nor lha gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor tshogs rnams/ /'od zer ser po'i drwa ba'i 'phro 'du yis/

/bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod dang / /dbang phyug snyan grags gzhan don phrin las rnams/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i las rnams mdzad par gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam/ gang drin ma sh+lau ka sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phogs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la/ oṃ gu ru rat+na saṃ bha wa maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i lta bas rtsis zin cing / dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma grangs ci mang / shes shing nus na so bdun ma gang gi mchod rdzas dang bcas pa bya/ bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim pa'i mod/ /rang nyid bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan sku/ /lnga brtsegs gdan steng rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /phyag gnyis mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can/ /'od zer dbye ba phrag brgya 'gyed pa yis/ /'dod rgu'i char gyis mkha' mnyam sems can gyi/ /yid la re ba mtha' dag rdzogs par gyur/ /de thams cad kyang rang sems gcig nyid kyi cho 'phrul du shes par byas la sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag go /rjes/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bla ma rin 'byung 'grub gyur nas/ sogs/ thams cad mkha'i mdzod bzhin du/ /sogs bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas btab la spyod lam thams cad du yang dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni rigs brgya'i khyab bdag thar rtse rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs kun bzang thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas rgyun pa'i thugs dam nyams su bzhes rgyur tshigs su bcad pa'i phreng bar bsdebs pa zhig dgos zhes bkas bskul ba la brten nas/
